title: Rami bar Pappa
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: [Yoma 77b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.77b.11) relates that Rav Yehudah and Rav Shmuel bar Yehudah were standing on the bank of the Euphrates at the ford of Chatzdad, and Rami bar Pappa was on the other side. He called out to them: “May I cross to come to you and ask a teaching?” Rav Yehudah answered him in the name of both Rav and Shmuel.[^1]

[Bava Batra 100b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.100b.7) relates that his sister was married to Rav Avya and died in his lifetime, and (her husband) made a ceremony of standing and sitting for her. Rav Yosef said: “He erred in two things.”

notes.text: Hyman gives the Euphrates. The consulted Yoma has Pappa in parentheses, and [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3240&lang=en) likewise gives the river Pappa. Yoma first has Rav Yehudah relay the ruling of Rav and Shmuel, then gives a version in which Rav Shmuel bar Rav Yehudah answers.
